headline: Peru Promotes Regional Hotel Projects to Panamanian Investors
summary: Promperú hosted an Invest Peru conference in Panama City to market foreign direct investment opportunities across seven Peruvian regions. The program targets Panamanian capital for new regional hospitality developments.
why: Peru's tourism and infrastructure sectors rely on foreign direct investment to expand hotel capacity and logistics networks.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Attracting foreign hotel capital builds regional commercial infrastructure and tourism capacity.
